Q: How to set headers in Soap Request Java A:

You can use this below line to add header before making a request, since you're using JAX-WS:

SOAPHeader header = envelope.addHeader();

Hope this helps.

Q: Populate TreeView from SQL Server database A:

With your DataTable, you can try this method below. If it doesn't find the parent node, it adds it. The "Find" function returns an array of nodes, but in this case, it's assumed none or one node is always found:

Private Sub AddNode(parentNode As String, nodeText As String)
  Dim node As New List(Of TreeNode)
  node.AddRange(TreeView1.Nodes.Find(parentNode, True))
  If Not node.Any Then
    node.Add(TreeView1.Nodes.Add(parentNode, parentNode))
  End If
  node(0).Nodes.Add(nodeText, nodeText)
End Sub

You would use it by enumerating through the rows in your DataTable:

For Each dr As DataRow In dt.Rows
  AddNode(dr("ParentNode").ToString, dr("NodeName").ToString)
Next
TreeView1.ExpandAll()

Q: How can I avoid using LLMs as a software developer? A:

Setting aside the ethical arguments above; I won't speak to those at this time, although I do have concerns as well in that regard as well; I'd like to speak only to the technology.
hey are merely reproducing their training dataset. - this isn't true exactly, they are not a database, if we are talking about specifically LLMs. They are probabilistically producing output, based on different types of algorithms, (function) weights, and (potentially very large) training dataset. The training process figures out a function from inputs/outputs - that is machine learning, and it is important to note that not all machine learning is LLMs (and not all AI is ML either).

LLMs/other types of AIs have solved problems that humans haven't (at least in a certain way / narrow problem space): Here is one example: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-023-06924-6

Also, FWIW, it's not completely generated by AI, but here is an article about using AI to write a programming language: https://github.com/ImJasonH/ImJasonH/blob/main/articles/llm-programming-language.md
